products.name: Clenbuterol(Clen)
products.description:
Known as: Clenbuterol, Clen

Dosage: 40 mcg/tab

Total amount: 50 tablets

Effect on muscle mass: A beta-2 adrenergic agonist primarily used as a bronchodilator. It is associated with increased thermogenesis and metabolic activity and is often misused for fat loss and physique enhancement. It is not an anabolic steroid. Potential side effects include increased heart rate, tremors, insomnia, muscle cramps, and serious cardiovascular complications.

Administration: Oral (tablets).

products.name: Anadrol(Oxymetholone)
products.description:
Known as: Anadrol, Oxymetholone

Dosage: 50mg/tab

Total amount: 60 tablets

Effect on muscle mass: A potent anabolic-androgenic steroid associated with rapid increases in muscle mass and strength. It may also increase red blood cell production and cause water retention. Oxymetholone carries significant risks, including liver toxicity and adverse effects on cholesterol and cardiovascular health.

Administration: Oral (tablets).

products.name: Aklief® (Trifarotene) 0.005% Cream, pump
products.description:
Size: pump bottle, listed as 75 g on the page (the size is only given in the product image, so check it on the page)
Form: Cream, topical (for the skin)
Price: £48.49 for one pump, £46.75 each if you take two. The page says the price includes a free online consultation and a private prescription, reviewed by a pharmacist.

Aklief is a prescription topical retinoid with trifarotene 0.005% (50 micrograms per gram). It is used to treat acne on the face and on the trunk (chest, shoulders and back). It works on the retinoid receptor that is most common in the skin, which helps clear and prevent pimples and blackheads, reduces inflammation and helps with marks left after acne.

How to use: cream, apply once a day in the evening to clean, dry skin. Prime the pump with up to 10 presses before the first use. Use 1 pump for the face, 2 for the upper trunk and 1 extra for the middle or lower back. Do not use more than 4 pumps a day. Use a moisturiser from the start of treatment.

products.name: Adapalene 0.1% Gel (Differin)
products.description:
Size: 45 g (1.6 oz) tube
Form: Gel, topical (for the skin)

Adapalene is a topical retinoid, a vitamin A derivative. It is used to treat acne: it helps clear and prevent pimples, blackheads and clogged pores, and calms inflammation by normalizing skin cell turnover. It is the mildest of the acne retinoids and is sold over the counter in the US (prescription-only in some other countries).

How to use: gel, apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin in the evening.

products.name: Isotretinoin (Roaccutane / Accutane type)
products.description:
Size: the pack in the photo shows 60 soft capsules. The strength is not visible on the page, so check it before sending.
Form: Capsules, taken by mouth

Isotretinoin is a prescription vitamin A derivative taken as capsules. It is used for severe acne, or acne that has not responded to antibiotics and other treatments. It strongly reduces oil production and inflammation in the skin and can give long-lasting results.

How to use: capsules, taken by mouth with a meal.

products.name: Tazarotene 0.1% Cream (generic Tazorac®)
products.description:
Size: 30 g tube (about a 45-day supply)
Form: Cream, topical (for the skin)
Price on RedBox Rx: $75 for a 30 g tube. The page marks it as prescription only: eligibility is decided by a licensed provider during an online evaluation.

Tazarotene is a prescription topical retinoid, a vitamin A derivative. It is used to treat acne: it helps clear and prevent pimples and clogged pores by speeding up skin cell turnover. It is also prescribed for fine lines, wrinkles and uneven texture, and in some cases for plaque psoriasis. It is one of the stronger topical retinoids.

How to use: cream, apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin in the evening.

products.name: Retin-A (Tretinoin) Topical Cream
products.description:
Size: 20 g tube (about a 30-day supply)
Form: Cream, topical (for the skin)
Price on Amazon Pharmacy: $18.98 without insurance (retail price $19.60). The page marks it as prescription required (Rx).

Retin-A is a prescription topical retinoid, a vitamin A derivative. It is used to treat acne: it helps clear and prevent pimples, blackheads and clogged pores by speeding up skin cell turnover. Doctors also prescribe it for fine wrinkles, uneven texture and some signs of sun damage.

How to use: cream, apply a thin layer to clean, dry skin in the evening. The schedule is set by a doctor, and the skin usually needs a few weeks to adjust.

products.name: Differin Adapalene Gel 0.1%
products.description:
Volume: 45 g (1.6 oz) tube
A once-daily topical retinoid (adapalene 0.1%). Used for acne: helps clear and prevent pimples, blackheads and clogged pores, and calms inflammation by normalizing skin cell turnover. Over-the-counter in the US. May cause dryness and irritation at first. Not for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use sunscreen during the day.
How to use: Gel, topical. Apply a thin layer in the evening.

products.name: The Ordinary Retinal 0.2% Emulsion
products.description:
Volume: 15 ml
A water-free emulsion with 0.2% stabilized retinal (retinaldehyde), a stronger vitamin A form than retinol. Used for firmness, uneven texture, first fine lines and signs of sun damage. Best for people who already tolerate retinoids. Can stain light fabrics. Not for use during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Use sunscreen during the day.
How to use: Emulsion, topical. Apply a small amount in the evening.

products.name: Harbinger Padded Cotton Lifting Straps
products.description:

How to use: Loop the strap around your wrist, wrap it around the bar and tighten. Clean with water and mild detergent. 90-day warranty.

products.name: Harbinger Figure 8 Padded Lifting Straps

products.name: Harbinger 6-inch Padded Leather Belt 2.0

Genuine split-leather weightlifting belt with interior foam padding, a tapered edge for range of motion on Olympic lifts, a dual-prong steel roller buckle and double stitching. Supports the lower back on heavy squats and deadlifts.

products.name: Harbinger Pro WristWrap Weightlifting Gloves

products.name: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey, 2 lb
